specs.title: Multi-tenancy middleware
specs.why: Tenant isolation must be enforced structurally before any tenant data is written, or every later query is a leak risk.
specs.scope: Add request-scoped tenant resolution from subdomain or session. Build a Prisma client extension that rejects queries on tenant-scoped models when `tenantId` is absent from the `where` clause.
tasks: Wrap the Prisma client with a tenant-guard extension
Unit tests: cross-tenant read throws; correct tenant passes
acceptance: A cross-tenant query throws in test
A valid tenant query returns the expected row

specs.title: Auth with phone + OTP
specs.why: Phone-first login matches how the target market actually signs in, and everything owner-facing sits behind it.
specs.scope: Implement phone-number authentication with OTP through an SMS provider port. Normalize Nigerian numbers to E.164 (+234). Use signed HTTP-only session cookies.
specs.non_goals: Use a stubbed/faked SMS adapter in tests. Do not require live Termii credentials to pass CI.
tasks: Add a `SmsProvider` interface and a Termii adapter
Implement OTP generation, storage, 5-minute expiry and rate limiting
acceptance: A user can sign up and log in by phone + OTP
Expired or already-used OTP is rejected
